Specification of Diagnostics
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
It is assumed, that there is only a single
proximity_challenge
present at any point
in time, that is valid for all SOVD clients and all
operations
. Therefore, a typical
application implementing
ara::diag::SovdProximityChallenge
does not need
to manage an individual
proximity_challenge
for each requested operation and
for each client.
The lifetime of a
proximity_challenge
is typically set to a fixed time by the appli-
cation (e.g. 2 minutes).
If further complexity, such as different
proximity_challenges
per client are
needed, the
ara::diag::MetaInfo
object can be evaluated by the application, to
implement client or operation specific
proximity_challenges
. But in most cases
this will not be necessary.
[SWS_DM_01398] Providing the
SOVD
operation
proximity_challenge

RS_Diag_04262
⌈
If a SOVD
operation
has
DiagnosticSovdOperation.proximityProofRe-
quired
set to
TRUE
, in each response body where the attribute
proxim-
ity_challenge
is required, the
Diagnostic Server instance
shall return the
attribute in the response body of the SOVD method with the value returned by
ara::
diag::SovdProximityChallenge::GetChallenge
.
⌋

SOVD
operation
mode

modes

[SWS_DM_01395] Validation of
SOVD
operation
proximity_response
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04262
⌈
If a SOVD request body contains a
proximity_response
, the
Diagnostic
Server instance
shall call the method
ara::diag::SovdProximityChal-
lenge::ValidateResponse
with the parameter proximityResponse set to the con-
tent from the request body and consider the
proximity_challenge
valid, if
kProx-
imityChallengeValidationSuccessful
is returned.
⌋
